subject: Linguistics
title: Pragmatics vs Semantics
description: A quick win: understand Pragmatics vs Semantics.

hook.text: 'Some students passed' semantically means at least one. Pragmatically, it implies not all did.

buildup.text: Semantics handles what sentences mean in isolation; pragmatics handles what speakers mean in context.

discovery.text: The boundary between the two is heavily debated—some meanings straddle the line.

twist.text: Irony is semantic nonsense but pragmatic gold—meaning gets flipped by context.

climax.text: Both fields are needed: semantics provides the foundation, pragmatics adds the real-world layer.

punchline.text: Semantics is what the words say; pragmatics is what you mean.

quiz.question: What distinguishes pragmatics from semantics?
options: Pragmatics deals with speaker meaning in context
